Timeline: force magnitude |F| = sqrt(fx²+fy²+fz²) per fingertip, above its resting value (top = left hand, bottom = right hand, same y scale; raw sensor units); click to jump. Dashed vertical lines mark the first and last frame with any hand or arm motion, when the file has them. Table: peak and mean |F| over the episode. Colours: thumb red, index green, middle blue, ring orange, pinky purple. Tile numbers: highest point on that fingertip at this frame / force above rest. Unless "same colour scale" is ticked, each fingertip's colour scale runs from 0 to its highest value in the episode. Arrow keys step one frame.
